definitions.full: H6182. arisah [ עֲרִיסָה ] noun feminine meaning dubious, usually coarse meal ; ᵐ5 AV RV dough, so Toy (with ?) (Late Hebrew עַרְסָן barley-meal ; Syriac (in Lexicons) hulled barley , or (compare Lag GGN 1889, 301 f. ) wheat ); > Sm Ez Co Ez kneading-trough (so Late Hebrew עֲרִיסָה Jastr; apparently secondary, עֲרִיסָה also [ bed ], cradle , see ערשׂ ); — only עֲרִיסֹתֵיכֶם רֵאשִׁית Ezek 44:30 , ׳ר עֲרִיסֹתֵינוּ Neh 10:38 ; ׳ר עֲרִסֹתֵיכֶם Num 15:20-21 , (P). עֲרוֺעֵר עֲרֹעֵר, עַרְעֹר, עַרְעָר, see ערר . I. ערף (√ of following; meaning dubious; Late Hebrew עוֺרֶף = Biblical Hebrew; Arabic mane of horse, also part of neck where hair grows, etc.).
